sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日简报》节目。

sentences.en: The FBI investigation into Judge Brett Kavanaugh is now underway.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局对布雷特·卡瓦诺法官的调查现已展开。

sentences.en: At the same time, more and more former classmates of Kavanaugh's are coming forward with personal stories about the judge.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，越来越多卡瓦诺以前的同学站出来，讲述关于这位法官的个人故事。

sentences.en: But it's unclear whether the investigation will take those stories into account.
sentences.zh: 但目前尚不清楚调查是否会将这些故事纳入考量。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, October 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月2日，星期二。

sentences.en: Robin Pogerman, you typically cover culture for the Times.
sentences.zh: 罗宾·波格曼，你通常负责《时报》的文化报道。

sentences.en: And Kate Kelly, you typically cover business for the Times.
sentences.zh: 凯特·凯利，你通常负责《时报》的商业报道。

sentences.en: So how did you both end up reporting on Brett Kavanaugh?
sentences.zh: 那么你们俩是怎么开始报道布雷特·卡瓦诺的呢？

sentences.en: I actually went to Yale, and I was Brett Kavanaugh's classmate.
sentences.zh: 其实我上的是耶鲁大学，我是布雷特·卡瓦诺的同学。

sentences.en: I was the class of 1987.
sentences.zh: 我是1987届的。

sentences.en: And the deeper I got into reporting this story, it turns out I was actually in his freshman year dorm as well.
sentences.zh: 随着我对这个故事的深入报道，发现我大一的时候竟然和他住在同一个宿舍楼里。

sentences.en: So I have a vague memory of him.
sentences.zh: 所以我对他有一点模糊的记忆。

sentences.en: But more importantly, I have sort of tangential connections to some of the classmates we had in common.
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，我和我们共同认识的一些同学有某种间接的联系。

sentences.en: And Kate, what about you?
sentences.zh: 凯特，你呢？

sentences.en: Similar in the sense that I grew up in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 情况类似，因为我在华盛顿特区长大，

sentences.en: and went to one of the all-girls schools in that area.
sentences.zh: 并就读于该地区的一所女子学校。

sentences.en: Not one of the ones that's been a focal point in these Kavanaugh stories, but still in that same broad circle of private single-sex schools.
sentences.zh: 虽然不是这些卡瓦诺故事中提到的重点学校，但仍然属于私立单性别学校的那个大圈子里。

sentences.en: I did not have good friends that went to Georgetown Prep.
sentences.zh: 我没有去乔治城预科学校的好朋友。

sentences.en: Which is where Brett Kavanaugh went.
sentences.zh: 那是布雷特·卡瓦诺就读的地方。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But I did get some documents a couple of weeks ago from somebody who knew Kavanaugh at the
sentences.zh: 但我几周前从一位当时认识卡瓦诺的人那里得到了一些文件，

sentences.en: time and thought I should get a better picture of what his social life was in high school and in particular what his attitude was towards young women at that time.
sentences.zh: 他认为我应该更全面地了解卡瓦诺高中的社交生活，特别是他当时对年轻女性的态度。

sentences.en: So I guess kind of entirely by coincidence, both of your lives intersect with the educational life of Brett Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜，完全出于巧合，你们两人的生活都与布雷特·卡瓦诺的教育生涯产生了交集。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Kate, given your background, your understanding of the private school culture outside Washington,
sentences.zh: 那么凯特，考虑到你的背景，以及你对华盛顿以外私立学校文化的了解，

sentences.en: when Dr. Christine Blasey Ford makes this allegation that Brett Kavanaugh has sexually assaulted her, what did you do next?
sentences.zh: 当克里斯汀·布莱西·福特博士指控布雷特·卡瓦诺性侵她时，你接下来做了什么？

sentences.en: It was a little while after that that I got these documents.
sentences.zh: 那之后没过多久我就收到了这些文件。

sentences.en: Saying, you know, you should understand that he was not respectful toward women.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，你应该明白他对女性并不尊重。

sentences.en: And in particular, there was one woman that I was suggested to look into, a woman named
sentences.zh: 特别是有位女性建议我调查一下，她叫

sentences.en: Renata Schroeder, now Renata Dolphin.
sentences.zh: 蕾娜塔·施罗德，现在叫蕾娜塔·多芬。

sentences.en: So I got this information and I passed it on to members of the team who were working on
sentences.zh: 所以我得到了这个信息，并把它传给了团队中负责

sentences.en: Kavanaugh, the Kavanaugh story and his background.
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺故事及其背景调查的成员。

sentences.en: And we talked about it and there were a lot of different leads we were pursuing.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论了这件事，当时我们正在追踪许多不同的线索。

sentences.en: And I said, hey, let me just make a few phone calls, see how far I can get.
sentences.zh: 我说，嘿，让我打几个电话，看看能查到什么程度。

sentences.en: So I started reaching out to some other D.C.
sentences.zh: 于是我开始联系华盛顿特区的其他人，

sentences.en: people, some Georgetown Prep people who I thought might be able to help me fill the picture out.
sentences.zh: 一些乔治城预科学校的人，我认为他们可能有助于我完善这个画像。

sentences.en: And as I went along, I developed some string on this woman Renata Schroeder and the way in which Brett Kavanaugh and some of his friends had treated her.
sentences.zh: 随着调查的深入，我发现了一些关于蕾娜塔·施罗德的线索，以及布雷特·卡瓦诺和他的朋友们对待她的方式。

sentences.en: And Kate, as you were making these calls to see where this string led you, what were people telling you about Kavanaugh in particular?
sentences.zh: 凯特，当你打这些电话追踪线索时，人们具体是怎么评价卡瓦诺的？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK They were telling me that he was not respectful
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他们告诉我，他对这位女性并不尊重，当时他本人以及他的许多朋友在所谓的性征服方面表现得非常狂妄自大。

sentences.en: toward this woman and that there was a lot of braggadocio at the time on his part, but also the part of many of his friends about supposed sexual conquests.
sentences.zh: 他们指引我去看他自己的个人年鉴页面。

sentences.en: They pointed me to his own personal yearbook page.
sentences.zh: 布雷特·卡瓦诺的页面非常详细，坦率地说，还包含了一些代码，里面有很多无法立即辨认的指代内容。

sentences.en: Brett Kavanaugh had a particularly detailed and frankly coded page where there were a lot of references to things that weren't immediately discernible.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是“蕾娜塔校友”，蕾娜塔拼写为 R-E-N-A-T-E。

sentences.en: One of them was Renata Alumni with Renata spelled R-E-N-A-T-E.
sentences.zh: 问题是，那是什么意思？

sentences.en: And the question was, what was that?
sentences.zh: 这个人把照片发给我说，当时这群男生吹嘘一个叫蕾娜塔的年轻女性，说他们都和她有过某种性接触。

sentences.en: And this person sent me the photo and said, at the time, these group of boys bragged about a young woman named Renata and having all had some kind of sexual interaction with her.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的吹嘘内容，也是他们有所谓“俱乐部”的原因。

sentences.en: That was the brag and that was why they had a so-called club.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：凯特，当你试图还原卡瓦诺高中时代的样子时，你实际上和多少人谈过？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And Kate, as you're trying to get a picture of Kavanaugh in his high school days, how many people did you actually talk to?
sentences.zh: 这些人愿意和你交谈吗？

sentences.en: And how eager are those people to talk to you?
sentences.zh: 我想说人们相当不情愿。

sentences.en: I would say people were quite reluctant.
sentences.zh: 我最终和少数几个人谈过。

sentences.en: I ended up talking to a handful of people.
sentences.zh: 在找到愿意谈论此事的人之前，我们打了很多很多电话。

sentences.en: We made many, many phone calls before we reached people who were comfortable speaking about it.
sentences.zh: 人们普遍感到不情愿，并且对卷入这场日益扩大的全国性争议缺乏兴趣。

sentences.en: There was a general sense of reluctance and a lack of interest in stepping into what was becoming a bigger and bigger national controversy.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：你认为这是为什么？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Why do you think that is?
sentences.zh: 你认为是什么导致了这种不情愿？

sentences.en: What do you think explains that reluctance?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我认为乔治城预科学校的校友群体最终是非常紧密的。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I think the Georgetown Prep alumni community is ultimately very tight knit.
sentences.zh: 1983届毕业生只有100个男生。

sentences.en: That graduating class of 1983 was only 100 guys.
sentences.zh: 我认为，当他们中的一员被提名为最高法院大法官时，会产生一种自豪感。

sentences.en: And I think there's a sense of pride that comes with having one of their own be nominated to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 我从人们那里听到过这种说法，他们说，看，我是民主党人，但我仍然为卡瓦诺法官获得提名感到自豪。

sentences.en: I have heard this from people who say, look, I'm a Democrat, but I still take pride in Judge Kavanaugh being nominated.
sentences.zh: 这超越了政治。

sentences.en: This surpasses politics.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：罗宾，在布莱西·福特博士提出指控后，考虑到你与耶鲁大学的联系，你从哪里开始你的报道？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And Robin, where did you start your reporting after Dr. Blasey Ford makes her allegations, knowing your connections to Yale?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：在布莱西·福特博士的指控浮出水面后不久，我们就开始收到关于黛博拉·拉米雷斯这个名字的线索，说她也有故事要讲。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK So soon after Dr. Blasey Ford's allegations surfaced, we started getting tips about the name Deborah Ramirez, that she also had a story to tell.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：因此，我开始挖掘我的耶鲁经历和消息来源，四处打电话，联系我的Facebook好友，开始询问有关该事件的问题，

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And as a result, I started mining my Yale history and sources, calling around, going to my Facebook friends, and to begin to ask questions around the incident,
sentences.zh: 以及关于他们在大学一年级及以后是什么样子的更多背景信息。

sentences.en: as well as more atmospheric information about what those two were like in college, freshman year and afterwards.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：当你和耶鲁大学的前同学交谈时，他们是怎么描述大学时代的布雷特·卡瓦诺的？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And as you're talking to former Yale classmates, what are they saying about who Brad Kavanaugh was in college?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他是什么样的人？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK What kind of person he was?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他们描述的是一个非常喜欢聚会的人，以疯狂聚会而闻名。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Who they're describing is a person who was very much of kind of a party guy, known for partying hard.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我交谈过的人说我也和他一起聚会。

sentences.en: In fact, the people I talked to said I partied right along with him.
sentences.zh: 他们并不一定说自己相比之下是天使。

sentences.en: They didn't necessarily say they were angels in comparison.
sentences.zh: 当时酗酒很严重。

sentences.en: There was heavy drinking.
sentences.zh: 他也是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: He was part of it.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：但他们也说他是个“深藏不露”的聪明人。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK But they also said that he was kind of this sleeper, smart person.
sentences.zh: 没人真正知道他有多聪明、多有成就。

sentences.en: Nobody really knew how intelligent and accomplished he was.
sentences.zh: 他们中的几个人谈到在毕业那年甚至在毕业典礼上宣布学术荣誉时才了解到这一点。

sentences.en: And several of them talked about learning of that senior year or even at graduation when academic honors were announced.
sentences.zh: 听到布雷特的名字时，他们很惊讶。

sentences.en: And they were surprised to hear Brett's name.
sentences.zh: 许多人描述说对他说了同样的话：我们根本不知道你这么聪明。

sentences.en: And many of them described saying to him, we had no idea you were smart.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：根据你交谈过的人的说法，他酗酒和聚会的程度到底有多严重？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And just how hard drinking and partying was he, according to the people you talked to?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：布雷特参加了一个名为 Deke 的兄弟会。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Brett was in a fraternity that was known as Deke.
sentences.zh: Deke 在校园里臭名昭著。

sentences.en: And Deke was infamous on campus.
sentences.zh: 它实际上在1983年，也就是我们大一那年被禁了。

sentences.en: It was actually banned in 1983, which was our freshman year.
sentences.zh: 一年后，它在校外的一个地点重新回到了校园。

sentences.en: It came back to campus a year later in an off-campus location.
sentences.zh: 那时它就以过度饮酒、一些厌女行为和某种越界的狂野而闻名，现在依然如此。

sentences.en: And it was notorious then and continues to be for excessive drinking and for some misogynist behavior and kind of a wildness that crossed the line.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：布雷特是 Deke 的成员，他与这些记忆紧密相关，也和一群喜欢聚会的家伙混在一起。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And Brett was part of Deke, and he was very much closely associated with those memories, as well as just a bunch of guys who would have parties.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多人对我说，布雷特就是那个守在啤酒桶旁的人。

sentences.en: You know, a number of people said to me, Brett was the one at the keg.
sentences.zh: 他就是那个站在啤酒桶边的人。

sentences.en: He was the guy standing by the keg.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：在做什么？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Doing what?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：喝很多酒。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Drinking a lot.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：其实让我感兴趣的是，你知道，一个消息来源告诉我，布雷特想成为那个能追到女生的家伙，

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And actually what was interesting to me was that, you know, one source said to me that Brett wanted to be the guy who got the girls,
sentences.zh: 但他并不是那个能追到女生的家伙。

sentences.en: and he wasn't the guy who got the girls.
sentences.zh: 所以他倾向于喝很多酒，在某种程度上谈论女性时会使用不尊重的语言，但没人记得他约会过谁。

sentences.en: So he tended to drink a lot and to some extent use disrespectful language when talking about women, but no one could remember anyone he had dated.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：所以这呈现出一种有趣的画面，一个想成为校园风云人物的人，实际上却以“扶墙”而闻名。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK So there was this kind of an interesting picture of sort of a wannabe man about campus who actually really was known for holding up the walls.
sentences.zh: 这是我听过几次的短语。

sentences.en: That was a phrase I heard a few times.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：那是什么意思？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：意思是那个醉得厉害，需要靠墙站着的人，因为如果他离开墙，他可能会摔倒。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And that means the guy who's so drunk, he needs to stand along the wall because if he came away from the wall, he might fall.
sentences.zh: 所以布雷特以“扶墙”而闻名。

sentences.en: And so Brett was known for holding up the walls.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：今晚，最高法院提名人布雷特·卡瓦诺首次打破沉默。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Tonight, Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh breaks his silence for the first time.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：对我来说，我发现就在布雷特·卡瓦诺带着妻子出现在福克斯新闻频道，并将自己描绘成一个“唱诗班男孩”之后，

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK For me, I found that right after Brett Kavanaugh appeared on Fox with his wife and portrayed himself as something of a choir boy.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我专注于努力成为班级第一，担任校篮球队队长，做服务项目，去教堂。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I was focused on trying to be number one in my class and being captain of the varsity basketball team and doing my service projects, going to church.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：信息开始以一种更公开的方式传出，人们主动打电话给我说，等一下，那不是我认识的布雷特。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Information started to shake out in a more overt way where people were sort of proactively calling me and saying, wait a minute, that's not the Brett I knew.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人甚至说，你知道，你不能靠撒谎进入最高法院。

sentences.en: One of them went so far as to say, you know, you can't lie your way onto the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他们认为谎言是什么？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And what did they think was the lie?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：你知道，基本上就是布雷特在粉饰他的过去。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK You know, basically that Brett was whitewashing his paSt.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：有没有哪次你喝得太多，以至于不记得前一天晚上发生了什么？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Was there ever a time that you drank so much that you couldn't remember what happened the night before?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：不，从来没有发生过。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK No, that never happened.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：你从来没有对任何人说过，我不记得昨晚的任何事了吗？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK You never said to anyone, I don't remember anything about last night?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：没有。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK No.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他描绘了一个他们不认识的年轻人的版本，他们觉得这是虚伪的，这触及了性格层面，也关系到某人的正直和诚实，他们认为这是他们必须分享的重要信息。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK He was portraying a version of a young person that they did not recognize and they felt was disingenuous and that that went to the level of character and it spoke to someone's integrity and truthfulness and they thought it was important information for them to share.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：如果不是因为这个，他们可能不会站出来，但这触及了他们的底线。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK They may not have stepped forward otherwise, but this was a bright line he'd crossed.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：接着听证会开始了。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK So then came the hearing.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：你是否确认你即将向委员会提供的证词将是真相、全部真相，且除了真相别无其他，愿上帝帮助你？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Do you affirm that the testimony you're about to give before the committee will be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth, so help you God?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我确认。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I do.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：对我个人而言，在我的报道过程中，

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And for me, in my personal reporting process,
sentences.zh: 听证会是一个非常具有激励性的时刻，因为我正在处理这些当时认识卡瓦诺的乔治城预科校友，他们中有许多人之前一直不愿开口。

sentences.en: the hearing was a really galvanizing moment as I'm dealing with these Georgetown Prep alumni who knew Kavanaugh at the time, so many of whom had been reluctant to speak before.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：突然之间，我接到了打进来的电话说，这不是准确的描述。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK All of a sudden, I'm getting inbound calls saying, this is not an accurate portrayal.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我们本来想置身事外，但这简直太过分了。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK We wanted to stay out of this, but this is just over the top.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：在听证会上，他被问及蕾娜塔以及那些“蕾娜塔校友”的指代是什么意思，他说……

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK During the hearing, he was asked about Renata and what was meant by those Renata alumni references, and he said...
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：她是我们的好朋友。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK She was a great friend of ours.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我们一群人曾和她一起去跳舞。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK A bunch of us went to dances with her.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：她和我们一群人混在一起。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK She hung out with us as a group.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：她是我们非常尊重的一位亲密朋友。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK She's a dear friend that we really respect.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我真的很沮丧，这件事被断章取义了。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I'm really upset that this has been taken out of context.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：媒体炒作认为这指的是性。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK The media circus that has been generated by this thought and reported that it referred to sex.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我交谈过的那些当时认识他的人对此嗤之以鼻。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK The people I was talking to who knew him at the time cried BS on this.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他们说布雷特·卡瓦诺谈论她时很不尊重。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK They said Brett Kavanaugh spoke about her disrespectfully.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他的朋友们也是如此。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK So did his friends.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：这根本不是他所呈现的那样，那纯粹是谎言。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK It was not at all as he's presenting it, and that's just a lie.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：关于喝酒……

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK In terms of the drinking...
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我和朋友们喝啤酒。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I drank beer with my friends.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：卡瓦诺法官把自己表现成一个喜欢啤酒的人。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Judge Kavanaugh presented himself as someone who liked beer.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我依然喜欢啤酒。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I still like beer.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：有时我喝得太多了。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Sometimes I had too many beers.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：其他人也一样，然后他试图把矛头转向别人和其他话题。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK So did other people, and then tried to turn the table on other people and other topics.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我喜欢啤酒。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I like beer.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我喜欢啤酒。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I like beer.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我不知道你喜不喜欢啤酒，参议员。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I don't know if you like beer, Senator, or not.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：你喜欢喝什么？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK What do you like to drink?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：下一个是……

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Next one is...
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：参议员，你喜欢喝什么？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Senator, what do you like to drink?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：法官，你有没有……

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Judge, have you...
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：法官，你有没有……

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK You're saying there's never been a case where you drank so much that you didn't remember what happened the night before or part of what happened?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：你是说，从来没有发生过你喝得烂醉，以至于不记得前一天晚上发生了什么，或者只记得部分经过的情况吗？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK That's...
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：那是……

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK You're asking about, yeah, blackout.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：你问的是，没错，断片。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I don't know.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我不知道。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Have you...
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：你有没有……

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK So that's not happened.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：所以那种事没发生过。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Is that your answer?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：这就是你的回答吗？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Yeah, and I'm curious if you have.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：是的，我很好奇你有没有过。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I have no drinking problem, Judge.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：法官大人，我没有酗酒问题。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK He was not necessarily exceptional in the heavy drinking, at least at Georgetown Prep, but falling down drunk, stumbling downstairs, vomiting,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他在酗酒方面并不算特别出格，至少在乔治城预科学校时是这样，但醉到摔倒、滚下楼梯、呕吐，

sentences.en: all of these behaviors that we associate with excessive drinking that are at issue here happened to him and happened to a lot of us.
sentences.zh: 所有这些我们与酗酒联系在一起的行为，也就是这里讨论的问题，都发生在他身上，也发生在我们许多人身上。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And he's not being honest about that either.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：而且他在这一点上也不诚实。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK He was never the choir boy he's presenting himself to be.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他从来都不是他所表现出来的那种乖孩子。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Never, never, never.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：从来都不是，绝对不是。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK That was a text message that I got from somebody.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：那是我从某人那里收到的一条短信。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And the idea was that I, as a reporter, need to help sort this out because the public is being misled.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：其意图是，作为一名记者，我需要帮忙理清这件事，因为公众受到了误导。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And Robin, what happened in your reporting after last week's hearing,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：罗宾，在上周的听证会之后，你的报道中发生了什么？

sentences.en: after this testimony that prompted so many people to come out and talk about Brett Kavanaugh's high school days?
sentences.zh: 在这次促使许多人站出来谈论布雷特·卡瓦诺高中时代的证词之后？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK After the hearing, what was interesting was the gloves came off.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：听证会后，有趣的是，人们不再遮遮掩掩了。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK One of his Yale classmates says the person he portrayed himself to be today does not match the person she knew at Yale.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他的一位耶鲁同学说，他今天表现出的形象与她在耶鲁认识的那个人完全不符。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I mean, you suddenly saw some of the people who had been reluctant to speak to me in the first place on national television.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我是说，你突然看到了一些原本不愿在全国电视上跟我说话的人。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I don't buy it.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我不信。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I didn't, that's not the Brett I knew as soon as I met him in college.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我没觉得，那不是我大学一见到他时认识的布雷特。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK It's not the Brett I saw during four years at Yale.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：那不是我在耶鲁四年里看到的布雷特。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Talking about Brett as a drinker who would get incoherent.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：谈论布雷特是一个会喝到语无伦次的酒鬼。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK There is no doubt in my mind that while at Yale,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我毫不怀疑，在耶鲁期间，

sentences.en: he was a big partier, often drank to excess, and there had to be a number of nights where he does not remember.
sentences.zh: 他是个爱玩的人，经常酗酒，肯定有不少夜晚他是不记得的。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I had one of my sources say to me, anyone who says that he wasn't rip-roaring drunk isn't telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我的一位消息人士对我说，任何说他没有烂醉如泥的人都是在撒谎。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I would have stayed on the sidelines if he had said, I drank to excess in high school, I drank to excess in college, I did some stupid things,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：如果他说“我在高中时酗酒，在大学时酗酒，我做过一些蠢事”，我本来会袖手旁观的，

sentences.en: but I never sexually assaulted anybody.
sentences.zh: “但我从未性侵过任何人。”

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK But to lie under oath, to lie about that, then what else is true?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：但要在宣誓后撒谎，就那件事撒谎，那还有什么是真的呢？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK To be—to blur, you know, in the highest position in the judiciary in our land to not know the difference between truth and lies, that's just terrible.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：作为……模糊不清，你知道，身处我国司法系统的最高职位，却分不清真假，这太可怕了。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK They just kind of let loose in a whole new way.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他们只是以一种全新的方式彻底放飞自我了。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And what was also interesting was that whole sense of loyalty to him and those who are still protecting him also was eroded,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：同样有趣的是，那种对他以及那些仍在保护他的人的忠诚感也受到了侵蚀，

sentences.en: where this suddenly became a little bit of a come-to-Jesus moment, where people realized they had to choose sides, and if that meant losing friends, it was worth it.
sentences.zh: 这突然变成了一个“顿悟时刻”，人们意识到他们必须选择立场，如果这意味着失去朋友，那也是值得的。

sentences.en: The stakes were too high, and they were going to come down on the side of truth.
sentences.zh: 赌注太高了，他们决定站在真相这一边。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And who were some of the people who came forward?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：那么有哪些人站出来了呢？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Most noteworthy was one of my classmates named Chad Luddington.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：最值得注意的是我的一位同学，名叫查德·勒丁顿。

sentences.en: He was the class of 87.
sentences.zh: 他是87届的。

sentences.en: He was a basketball player, a very big guy.
sentences.zh: 他是一名篮球运动员，个子非常高大。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And he was very reluctant to speak prior to the hearings, and even after the hearings, he was only in contact through text,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他在听证会前非常不愿开口，即使在听证会后，他也只是通过短信联系，

sentences.en: and he said he might have something to say, but he wasn't ready to say it.
sentences.zh: 他说他可能有话要说，但他还没准备好说出来。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And then finally, he said he had a statement.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：最后，他说他有一份声明。

sentences.en: He was going to give it to me Monday, today.
sentences.zh: 他本打算周一，也就是今天给我。

sentences.en: He ended up giving it to me last night, and it was a pretty powerful statement.
sentences.zh: 他最终昨晚给了我，那是一份非常有力的声明。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK What did it say?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：上面说了什么？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK He talks about how he was formerly reluctant to speak, but he didn't necessarily think Brett's alcohol use in college had relevance,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他谈到他以前不愿开口，是因为他不一定认为布雷特在大学时的饮酒行为有相关性，

sentences.en: but that now, after hearing him on Fox and hearing him testify under oath before the Senate Judiciary Committee, he became, quote,
sentences.zh: 但现在，在听了他在福克斯新闻的采访以及他在参议院司法委员会的宣誓作证后，他表示，引用：

sentences.en: deeply troubled by what has been a blatant mischaracterization by Brett himself of his drinking at Yale, end quote.
sentences.zh: “对布雷特本人对其在耶鲁饮酒情况的公然歪曲感到深感不安”，引用结束。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And how does he describe the drinking he saw?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他是如何描述他所看到的饮酒情况的？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK He goes on to say that, especially in their first two years of college when he often drank with Brett, quote,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：他接着说，特别是在大学前两年，他经常和布雷特一起喝酒，引用：

sentences.en: on many occasions I heard Brett slur his words and saw him staggering from alcohol consumption, not all of which was beer.
sentences.zh: “我多次听到布雷特说话含糊不清，看到他因饮酒而摇摇晃晃，而且喝的不仅仅是啤酒。”

sentences.en: When Brett got drunk, he was often belligerent and aggressive.
sentences.zh: “当布雷特喝醉时，他经常好斗且具有攻击性。”

sentences.en: On one of the last occasions I purposely socialized with Brett.
sentences.zh: “在最后几次我特意与布雷特社交的场合之一。”

sentences.en: I witnessed him respond to a semi-hostile remark, not by diffusing the situation,
sentences.zh: “我目睹他回应一个半敌意的言论，不是通过化解局势，

sentences.en: but by throwing his beer in the man's face and starting a fight that ended with one of our mutual friends in jail.
sentences.zh: 而是把啤酒泼在那人脸上，并引发了一场斗殴，最终导致我们的一位共同朋友进了监狱。”

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK So he is actively refuting the characterization that Judge Kavanaugh offered in the Fox interview and, most importantly,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：所以他正在积极反驳卡瓦诺法官在福克斯采访中，以及最重要的是，

sentences.en: under oath before the Senate Judiciary Committee.
sentences.zh: 在参议院司法委员会宣誓作证时所做的描述。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK That's right.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：没错。

sentences.en: And even subsequently after putting this out yesterday, Chad talked to me about how it was important to him that we portray that this was about truth.
sentences.zh: 即使在昨天发布这些内容之后，查德还跟我谈到，向我们展示这一切是为了真相，对他来说有多重要。

sentences.en: It was not about college behavior.
sentences.zh: 这与大学行为无关。

sentences.en: And I think that is an important distinction.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个重要的区别。

sentences.en: That is what bothers people is the degree to which Brett is not representing himself accurately, not the behavior itself.
sentences.zh: 困扰人们的是布雷特没有准确地展示自己，而不是行为本身。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Well, I think Robin makes a good point here, which is that it's the idea of lying under oath that really disturbs people.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：嗯，我认为罗宾在这里说得很有道理，那就是在宣誓后撒谎的想法真的让人们感到不安。

sentences.en: I think people could overlook excessive drinking, maybe some crass comments.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们可以忽略酗酒，也许还有一些粗俗的评论。

sentences.en: I've talked to people who said, you know, I did worse than Brett did, whatever it was.
sentences.zh: 我跟人谈过，他们说，你知道，我做得比布雷特还过分，不管是什么事。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK But the idea that he would be untruthful about this, a sitting judge who's nominated for the Supreme Court,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：但想到他会在这件事上撒谎，一位被提名最高法院的在任法官，

sentences.en: that he would be dishonest and belligerent about these things on the stand, in front of the nation, in front of the Senate Judiciary Committee, really appalls them.
sentences.zh: 他在证人席上，在全国人民面前，在参议院司法委员会面前，对这些事情表现得不诚实和好斗，真的让他们感到震惊。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK That is the kind of thing where people say to you things like, it's the cover-up, not the crime.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：这就是人们会对你说“是掩盖真相，而不是犯罪本身”这类话的情况。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK When all this reporting started, the question originally that we were all asking was, did Brett Kavanaugh commit these alleged acts of sexual assault?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：当所有这些报道开始时，我们最初都在问的问题是，布雷特·卡瓦诺是否犯下了这些所谓的性侵行为？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And now the question is, in the process of defending himself against those charges,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：而现在的问题是，在为自己辩护以对抗这些指控的过程中，

sentences.en: did Kavanaugh knowingly mislead and deceive the public, and also members of the United States Senate,
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺是否故意误导和欺骗了公众，以及美国参议院的成员，

sentences.en: about what seem in comparison to those original allegations, like smaller matters?
sentences.zh: 关于那些与最初的指控相比，看起来像是小事的问题？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I think that's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我认为这绝对正确。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I think you've got what is a very grave and relevant to character and ability to serve on the Supreme Court,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我认为你所面临的是一个非常严重且与品格及在最高法院任职能力相关的问题，

sentences.en: accusations about unattempted sexual assault many years ago.
sentences.zh: 关于多年前未遂性侵犯的指控。

sentences.en: And then you have these behavioral aspects about drinking and possibly blacking out, and whether he could stand up straight, and bragging about a Renata alumni club,
sentences.zh: 然后你还有关于饮酒和可能断片，以及他是否能站直，还有吹嘘“雷纳塔校友俱乐部”的行为方面的问题，

sentences.en: which may have seemed like very marginal details even a week ago.
sentences.zh: 即使在一周前，这些看起来可能还是非常微不足道的细节。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK But now they seem to be front and center in evaluating the truthfulness and really the fitness of this judge.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：但现在它们似乎成了评估这位法官的诚实度，以及真正是否称职的核心问题。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I think one area that we perhaps haven't delved into enough is this idea of what being blackout drunk means.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我认为有一个领域我们可能还没有深入探讨，那就是“喝到断片”意味着什么。

sentences.en: I think that sometimes it's conflated with passing out, and it's easy for Brett Kavanaugh to say that he doesn't have a memory of doing that or didn't do that.
sentences.zh: 我认为有时它与“昏睡过去”混为一谈，布雷特·卡瓦诺很容易说他不记得做过那种事，或者没做过。

sentences.en: There is a feeling among many of the people I talk to that he was often in that condition, so that some of these events, which were so formative to those who experienced them,
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的许多人都有种感觉，他经常处于那种状态，所以其中一些对经历过的人来说具有形成性影响的事件，

sentences.en: may have been meaningless or non-existent to him.
sentences.zh: 对他来说可能毫无意义或根本不存在。

sentences.en: And that is something that they, you know, fully entertain as possible.
sentences.zh: 而那是他们，你知道，完全认为有可能的事情。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And I'm hearing the same thing.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我也听到了同样的事情。

sentences.en: There was one alumnus I talked to who said he actually believes both Christine Blasey Ford and he believes Brett Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的一位校友说，他实际上既相信克里斯汀·布莱西·福特，也相信布雷特·卡瓦诺。

sentences.en: He thinks Brett Kavanaugh, at least in terms of the Blasey Ford accusation, is telling the truth, as he recalls it.
sentences.zh: 他认为布雷特·卡瓦诺，至少在布莱西·福特的指控方面，在他记忆中是在说实话。

sentences.en: He thinks the missing link that might help be connective tissue for the two accounts is that Kavanaugh at the time had an over-drinking problem.
sentences.zh: 他认为可能有助于连接这两个说法的缺失环节是，卡瓦诺当时有严重的酗酒问题。

sentences.en: He blacked out, and he truly doesn't remember.
sentences.zh: 他断片了，他真的不记得了。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK So now that there's an FBI investigation into Dr. Blasey Ford's allegation, are the people that you've been talking to, Robin, from Brett Kavanaugh's time at Yale,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：既然联邦调查局现在正在调查布莱西·福特博士的指控，罗宾，你一直在交谈的那些布雷特·卡瓦诺在耶鲁时期的朋友，

sentences.en: are they saying what effect that FBI investigation is having on their decision to come forward and share their recollections?
sentences.zh: 他们是否在说联邦调查局的调查对他们站出来分享回忆的决定有什么影响？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I have several people who even have yet to share information with me who now said they're waiting to tell what they know to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我有几个人甚至还没跟我分享信息，他们现在说他们正在等待向联邦调查局讲述他们所知道的事情。

sentences.en: And then as these days have passed, they've lost faith in the idea that they're going to hear from the FBI.
sentences.zh: 随着日子一天天过去，他们对会收到联邦调查局消息的想法失去了信心。

sentences.en: And in some cases, some of them have taken it among themselves to reach out to the FBI on their own, either through their local Senate offices or through the FBI hotline.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们中的一些人已经主动通过当地参议院办公室或联邦调查局热线联系联邦调查局。

sentences.en: They are no longer confident that they will be hearing from the FBI,
sentences.zh: 他们不再确信自己会收到联邦调查局的消息，

sentences.en: and they do feel like it's important to convey what they have to say to that agency before this process is through.
sentences.zh: 他们确实觉得在程序结束前，把他们要说的话传达给那个机构很重要。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK So you're saying that there are more stories about Brett Kavanaugh that we haven't heard yet, and that they may be filtering through the FBI.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：所以你是说还有更多关于布雷特·卡瓦诺的故事我们还没听到，而且它们可能正在通过联邦调查局过滤？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK It seems that there's more connecting of dots that could happen,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：似乎还有更多的线索可以串联起来，

sentences.en: and that even now some of these sources are holding out hope that it goes straight to the people evaluating
sentences.zh: 即使现在，这些消息来源中的一些人仍抱有希望，希望这些信息能直接传达给评估

sentences.en: Judge Kavanaugh for this position rather than through the press and through me as a reporter, but that they are going to come back to me if they don't end up feeling satisfaction
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺法官这一职位的人，而不是通过媒体和作为记者的我，但如果他们最终对联邦调查局认真对待他们的担忧、经历和故事感到不满意，他们会回来找我。

sentences.en: about the fact that the FBI is taking their concerns and experience and stories seriously.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：凯特，你的消息来源是怎么告诉你关于这次联邦调查局调查的，以及它如何符合他们被迫站出来的感觉？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And Kate, what are your sources telling you about this FBI investigation and how it fits into their feeling compelled to come forward?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我听到的和罗宾听到的一样。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I'm hearing similar things to what Robin is.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我听说人们宁愿跟联邦调查局特工谈话，也不愿跟我谈，他们希望看到这个过程在幕后彻底完成，

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK I'm hearing that people would far prefer to talk to an FBI agent than to me, and that they want to see this process done thoroughly behind the scenes
sentences.zh: 而不必在公众领域引入可能具有破坏性的东西，除非它们在正确的背景下得到适当的评估。

sentences.en: without necessarily introducing things into the public realm that could be damaging before they're properly evaluated in the right context.
sentences.zh: 我也确实知道有人一直在等电话，但电话没响。

sentences.en: I do know of people as well that have been expecting their phone to ring, and it hasn't.
sentences.zh: 所以人们感到沮丧，因为这件事并没有以一种非常彻底的方式进行。

sentences.en: So there is a frustration that this is not being done in a terribly thorough fashion.
sentences.zh: 我认为当你和那些和他一起上大学的人交谈时，现在有这样一种担忧，

sentences.en: I think that when you talk to people who went to college with him, there is this concern now
sentences.zh: 如果参议院司法委员会和联邦调查局无法确定事实，

sentences.en: that if the Senate Judiciary Committee and the FBI are unable to kind of pin down the facts
sentences.zh: 并证实这些故事，那么这就成了衡量卡瓦诺法官是否称职的试金石，

sentences.en: and prove out these stories, that that becomes the litmus test for Judge Kavanaugh's fitness,
sentences.zh: 而事实上，现在的问题更宏大，它与他的品格是否值得有关。

sentences.en: when in fact the question now is larger, and it has to do with whether his character is worthy.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：以及他是否在说实话。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And whether he's telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：以及他是否在说实话。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And whether he's telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：所以我认为现在的问题是，即使所有这些人都能被听到，那些有故事要告诉联邦调查局并试图

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK So I think now the question is that even if all of these people do get heard, the ones who have stories for the FBI and who are trying
sentences.zh: 将它们公之于众的人，如果最终评估认为布雷特·卡瓦诺在高中和大学的背景和行为上没有说

sentences.en: to bring them to light, if there is the assessment ultimately that Brett Kavanaugh wasn't telling
sentences.zh: 实话，这对那些评估他的人来说是否足够相关和具有决定性。

sentences.en: the truth about his background and his conduct in high school and in college, whether that will be relevant and decisive enough for those who are evaluating him.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：基本上，参议院在乎吗？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Basically, does the Senate care?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：对。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Right.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：联邦调查局在乎吗？

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK And does the FBI care?
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：罗宾，凯特，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Robin, Kate, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：谢谢。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Thank you.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：周一，在民主党人日益强烈的批评声中，他们认为白宫限制了联邦调查局对卡瓦诺的调查，

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK On Monday, amid growing criticism from Democrats that the White House had restricted the FBI's investigation into Kavanaugh,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统授权该局通过采访任何其认为必要的人来扩大调查范围，只要调查在周五前完成即可。

sentences.en: President Trump authorized the Bureau to expand the probe by interviewing anyone it deems necessary, so long as the investigation is completed by Friday.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局最初只打算采访四个人，这意味着不会与第三位指控者朱莉·斯威特尼、卡瓦诺本人或其他人交谈。

sentences.en: The FBI had originally intended to interview just four people, which meant not speaking to a third accuser, Julie Swetney, Kavanaugh himself, or anyone else.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：我的白宫会做参议员们想要的任何事。

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK My White House will do whatever the senators want.
sentences.zh: 我愿意接受他们想要的任何东西。

sentences.en: I'm open to whatever they want.
sentences.zh: 我唯一想要的就是速度。

sentences.en: The one thing I want is speed.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：在周一的新闻发布会上被问及更广泛的调查时，

sentences.en: LESLIE KENDRICK Asked about the broader investigation during a news conference on Monday,
sentences.zh: 总统表示他愿意让联邦调查局采访斯威特尼和卡瓦诺等人。

sentences.en: the president said he was open to having the FBI interview both Swetney and Kavanaugh, among others.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，在联邦调查局调查仍在进行时，

sentences.en: A few hours later, with the FBI investigation still underway,
sentences.zh: 参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔宣布，他将在本周末之前安排参议院对卡瓦诺的确认进行全体投票。

sentences.en: Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell announced that he would schedule a full Senate vote on Kavanaugh's confirmation before the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 所以让我说得很清楚。

sentences.en: And so let me make it very clear.
sentences.zh: 无休止的拖延和阻挠的时代已经结束了。

sentences.en: The time for endless delay and obstruction has come to a close.
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺法官的提名已经通过委员会。

sentences.en: Judge Kavanaugh's nomination is out of committee.
sentences.zh: 我们正在这里进行审议。

sentences.en: We're considering it here on the floor.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，我们本周将进行投票。

sentences.en: And Mr. President, we'll be voting this week.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 一个月的时间让你越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能看到什么。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 在整个竞选过程中，我承诺重新谈判《北美自由贸易协定》。

sentences.en: Throughout the campaign, I promised to renegotiate NAFTA.
sentences.zh: 今天我们兑现了那个承诺。

sentences.en: And today we have kept that promise.
sentences.zh: 周一，在威胁墨西哥和加拿大征收关税和发动贸易战一年后，

sentences.en: On Monday, after a year of threatening Mexico and Canada with tariffs and a trade war,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统宣布达成一项协议，大幅修订《北美自由贸易协定》，这是一项已有24年历史的协议，他抱怨这对美国工人不公平。

sentences.en: President Trump announced an agreement to significantly revise the North American Free Trade Agreement, a 24-year-old deal that he complains is unfair to American workers.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·肯德里克：你是在说，从来没有发生过你喝得烂醉，以至于不记得前一天晚上发生了什么，或者只记得部分经过的情况吗？

sentences.en: I have long contended that NAFTA was perhaps the worst trade deal ever made.
sentences.zh: 我一直认为，《北美自由贸易协定》（NAFTA）或许是有史以来最糟糕的贸易协定。

sentences.en: Since NAFTA's adoption, the United States racked up trade deficits totaling more than $2 trillion.
sentences.zh: 自该协定通过以来，美国的贸易逆差总额已超过2万亿美元。

sentences.en: And it's a much higher number than that.
sentences.zh: 而且实际数字远不止于此。

sentences.en: The agreement, now rebranded as the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, or USMCA, would, among other things, encourage more car manufacturing inside the three countries,
sentences.zh: 这项现已更名为《美墨加协定》（USMCA）的协议，除其他事项外，将鼓励这三个国家内部进行更多的汽车制造，

sentences.en: open Canada's dairy market to U.S.
sentences.zh: 向美国开放加拿大的乳制品市场，

sentences.en: farmers, and make it easier for Mexican workers to form labor unions.
sentences.zh: 并让墨西哥工人更容易组建工会。

sentences.en: USMCA.
sentences.zh: 美墨加协定。

sentences.en: And that'll be the name, I guess, that 99% of the time we'll be hearing, USMCA.
sentences.zh: 我想，我们99%的时间里听到的名字都会是这个，美墨加协定。

sentences.en: It has a good ring to it.
sentences.zh: 听起来还不错。

sentences.en: A major breakthrough in the negotiations came after Trump, having already imposed tariffs on Canadian aluminum and steel, threatened tariffs on Canadian cars.
sentences.zh: 谈判取得重大突破是在特朗普对加拿大铝和钢征收关税，并威胁要对加拿大汽车征收关税之后。

sentences.en: Once approved, this will be a new dawn for the American auto industry and for the American auto worker.
sentences.zh: 一旦获得批准，这将是美国汽车工业和美国汽车工人的新曙光。

sentences.en: They will see.
sentences.zh: 他们会看到的。

sentences.en: They understand.
sentences.zh: 他们明白。

sentences.en: During a news conference, Trump said that his hardball tactics in renegotiating NAFTA would now be a model for future negotiations with the rest of America's trade partners.
sentences.zh: 在新闻发布会上，特朗普表示，他在重新谈判NAFTA时采取的强硬策略，现在将成为未来与美国其他贸易伙伴进行谈判的典范。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，和我一起，莎拉·凯尼格，讲述那些试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的人们的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何平台收听。
